title: v0 run #4 — schema lock 1.0
explanation:
An independent grader found all criteria met:

- Whole-estate impact report (impact-summary.md, impact-report.md, impact-report.json) meets rubric criteria 1-7 (met): I checked all three files and the sandbox. All seven criteria are met; there is one cosmetic defect.

(1) Inventory: 164 components across all three modules (46 production, 5 test, 113 build-toolchain). Each one has current → latest → latest security patch, a source link and the file:line where it is declared. Oracle DB 19.3.0.0.0 with no RU is compared against RU 19.32 (Jul 2026 CPU) plus the Aug/Sep 2026 CSPUs, and ALERT-01 is raised with the text "DATABASE BEHIND THE LATEST CRITICAL PATCH UPDATE".

(2) CVEs: 615 IDs in the JSON. Every one has CVSS, severity, fixed_in and an NVD, GHSA or Oracle URL. I ran 15 random IDs through OSV and all resolved, including the 2026 Tomcat, spring-retry and spring-security ones. I also fetched the Oracle CPU/CSPU pages: all 58 Oracle CVE-2026 IDs listed for the DB, OJVM, JDBC and JDK appear there. Items that could not be confirmed are tagged UNVERIFIED (MOS patch numbers, OL minor version, RU certification on OL7).

(3) Code-located impact: IMP-REST-BOOT4 lists 30 breaking changes, IMP-NG-22 lists 23 and IMP-INFRA-PY lists 10, plus the JDK, JDBC and DB impacts. Each has a file:line, and the intermediate steps are given (Boot 2.7.18 → 3.5.16 → 4.1.1, then ng update one major at a time). I checked a sample against the pinned checkouts and they are accurate: healthcheck.py:20 yaml.load and :21 collections.Mapping, OwnerRestController.java:55 APPLICATION_JSON_UTF8_VALUE, BasicAuthenticationAdapter.java:18 WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter, application.properties:24 context-path, error.service.ts:65 Observable.throwError, polyfills.ts:73 zone.js/dist/zone, oracle-profile.xml:7 ojdbc6.

(4) Cross-module: section 6 covers:
- the REST contract from Angular and from the ops script to rest, with evidence (environment.ts, owner.service.ts, date format, context path, Jackson serialization proven in R09/R13);
- ojdbc6 vs DB 19c and the JDK (ojdbc17);
- JDK and Python declared in db-inventory.yaml:13-14 vs what the code needs;
- Maven Wrapper and CI Node.
It then gives a 10-step migration order with dependencies.

(5) Builds: 43 attempted, 10 passed, with 62 evidence logs. This covers the Java module on OpenJDK 17 and Temurin 25 (Boot 2.7/3.5/4.1.1), Angular 22.2.0 on Node 24 (build plus Playwright UI tests) and Python 3.14. Real errors are quoted (e.g. "release version 1.8 not supported", ERESOLVE codelyzer, TS2882 rxjs/Rx, longintrepr.h) and each is mapped to an IMP id. The Oracle live test is marked NOT_ATTEMPTED with the exact reason (no Docker daemon, MOS credentials required).

(6) Delta and consistency: the report opens with "New since last scan", correctly marked as not a baseline because a previous state exists in memory. The JSON validates with 0 errors against the task schema under Draft202012Validator with a format checker. There is one alert per component_key. Every JSON CVE ID appears in the MD, and the counts match (332 production CVEs: 53 critical / 129 high / 124 medium / 26 low). The memory state was rewritten keyed by component_key.

(7) Summary: 46 lines. It has the verdict, new items, top 5 alerts with fix and anchor links (all anchors exist in the MD), decisions, migration order and severity counts, and the counts match the MD.

Minor defect: the summary's Spring Boot alert row contains the unrendered template text `{nids("jackson-databind")}` where the advisory count should be (the MD says 56). This is cosmetic and does not affect the other required content.
